name: Marrying Kin
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity of marriage as a union where a man leaves his parents to become one flesh with his wife, emphasizing a distinct and honorable bond. At the same time, God commands believers to avoid marrying close relatives, forbidding approaching those near of kin to uncover their nakedness, thus preserving holiness within family relationships. Marriage is to be kept undefiled, with God judging those who violate its sacredness through immorality or adultery. Together, these teachings highlight God's design for marriage as a pure, exclusive covenant between husband and wife, distinct from familial ties.
